data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## What
Write failing unit tests for bridge/_outbound_cursor.py functions in tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py. Module does not exist yet — imports will fail.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Import: from bridge._outbound_cursor import read_cursor, write_cursor, fetch_events_since_cursor, CHECKPOINT_FILENAME

### Cold-start tests
- test_read_cursor_no_file: read_cursor(tmp_path) returns None when .outbound-checkpoint.json absent
- test_cold_start_seeds_at_head: when cursor is None, fetch_events_since_cursor seeds at HEAD (returns events from HEAD commit only), writes BRIDGE_ALERT

### 4 recovery case unit tests (all must trigger seed-at-HEAD + BRIDGE_ALERT)
- test_cursor_malformed_json: .outbound-checkpoint.json contains 'not-json' → same as cold-start
- test_cursor_missing_sha_field: checkpoint has no last_processed_sha key → same as cold-start
- test_cursor_unreachable_sha: checkpoint SHA does not exist in git history → same as cold-start
- test_cursor_ahead_of_head: checkpoint SHA is newer than HEAD → same as cold-start

### Multi-commit fixture test
- test_fetch_events_three_commits: create tmp git repo, make 3 commits each adding 1 event file (.tickets-tracker/T1/ts-uuid-STATUS.json etc.); cursor at commit-1 SHA; fetch_events_since_cursor returns all 3 event files (not just the last commit)

### Per-event advance test
- test_write_cursor_advances: write_cursor(tmp_path, sha='abc123', run_id='run1') writes {last_processed_sha: 'abc123', last_run_id: 'run1'} to .outbound-checkpoint.json atomically; subsequent read_cursor returns same sha

### 500-commit cap test
- test_500_commit_cap: with >500 commits in fixture, fetch_events_since_cursor triggers BRIDGE_ALERT and seeds at HEAD

All tests must fail RED (ImportError) before bridge/_outbound_cursor.py is created.

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py
data.title: RED: unit tests for OutboundCursor — cold-start, 4 recovery cases, multi-commit fixture, per-event advance
